info.bio:
Emperor pertenecen a la segunda oleada de bandas de black metal escandinavo que surgieron entre los años 1992 y 1994.

Fundada en 1991 en Notodden (Noruega), los dos personajes centrales de la banda y únicos miembros que participaron en todas sus grabaciones fueron Ihsahn y Samoth. 

De los demás músicos que han pasado por la banda cabe destacar a Mortiis, que sería el bajista en las primeras grabaciones de la banda antes de emigrar a Suecia y dedicarse a sus propios proyectos.

scenes.name: Black metal noruego
scenes.book: Heavy Metal: The Music and Its Culture
scenes.author: Deena Weinstein
scenes.desc: El término viene de una canción de Venom, pero en los noventa ya no designa una temática sino un estilo sonoro nacido en Noruega con Mayhem y Burzum: sobre una base de death metal añade capas de teclados cósmicos, voces chirriantes y músicos pintados de cadáver. Sus fundadores se tomaban en serio el satanismo: profanaciones de cementerios, iglesias quemadas y asesinatos que, como los antecedentes de los gangsta rappers, le dieron un aire de autenticidad. Crece exponencialmente en el norte de Europa (Emperor y Dimmu Borgir ya cruzan el Atlántico) y a su vez se fragmenta hacia lo new age (Tiamat, Burzum) o hacia el gótico (Cradle of Filth, Theatre of Tragedy).

scenes.name: Metal de los noventa: progresivo, death y black metal
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: Si los ochenta fueron la edad de oro del heavy metal, los noventa lo fragmentan en estilos que amplían ideas anteriores. El pop-metal (Warrant, Extreme, Live) es lo menos significativo; Marilyn Manson casa el scum-rock de Alice Cooper con el industrial de Nine Inch Nails. El metal progresivo (Warrior Soul, Dream Theater, Royal Hunt, Opeth, los suizos Alboth!). El death metal muta en algo más terrible y más musical gracias a Brutal Truth, Cannibal Corpse y, sobre todo, la tríada de Type O Negative (Slow Deep And Hard, misas negras wagnerianas), Today Is The Day y Fear Factory; Biohazard, Coalesce, Dillinger Escape Plan. El nuevo black metal escandinavo: Entombed, Darkthrone, Immortal, Mayhem, Enslaved, Emperor, Satyricon, Cradle Of Filth.

podcast.body: Emperor's albums included instrumental pieces that aimed to give an epic and atmospheric feel to the overall work, a common practice in Black Metal. "Las podemos escuchar en discos de Slate o Enperor."

podcast.body: Faust, the drummer for the black metal group Emperor, was sentenced to 14 years in prison for the murder of a gay man. "Faust, the drummer for a black metal group called Emperor, was given 14 years for killing a gay man."

xref.title: Collective Formed in 1994 (Montreal)
xref.body: Godspeed You! Black Emperor, a collective formed in Montreal in 1994, is fiercely independent with its own label and has garnered a global cult following. They are highly influential in the post-rock universe. "In Montreal, there is Godspeed U-Black Emperor, a collective formed in 1994."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Collaboration with Steve Albini
xref.body: The legendary producer Steve Albini, known for his work with Nirvana and Pixies, also worked on albums with Godspeed You! Black Emperor. "This is from a 2009 album entitled Him to the Immortal Wind, which is a big fan favorite and recorded by the legendary Steve Elbeni, who did all those albums with Nirvana and the Pixies and the Breeders and Bush. And here we go again, Godspeed you, Black Emperor."

xref.title: Continued Activity in the 90s
xref.body: The band, a Canadian group, continued their distinct musical approach into the late 1990s, further cementing their role in the post-rock scene. "Canada's Godspeed U-Black Emperor kept doing whatever they were doing."

xref.title: Defining Post-Rock
xref.body: Stereolab was among the bands in the 1990s that emerged during the alt-rock explosion, contributing significantly to the definition of post-rock with their experimental sound. "And because Grunge and everything else that went along with it opened people's ears to new ideas, we got bands like StereoLab and Tortoise and the wild Godspeed U-Black Emperor, the Montreal Collective, that went a long way towards defining what we're talking about here."
